title: Semiclassical foundation of universality in chaotic quantum circuits
summary: The fundamental correspondence between quantum chaotic single-particle systems and random matrix theory is well-understood via periodic orbit theory. In contrast, we show that many-body systems with explicit subsystem structure possess characteristics different from the single-particle theory. We present a periodic orbit theory for many-body systems with well defined semiclassical limit. For this we identify periodic orbit families arising exclusively in the many-body setting and implement a central limit theorem characterizing their correlations.
